edge_cases: out = P . V (post-softmax attention-weight proxy P times values V); V is already in the generic B[K,N] matmul layout so no transpose/index-swap trick needed (unlike the QK^T sibling task)
2x2 grid of 32x32 output tiles; each accumulates over 2 S-tiles (reduction over keys)
HMX accumulator persists across S-tile matmuls (one mxclracc per out tile)
activation int8 in high byte of crouton slot (low bytes dead)
weight 4-deep packed; different load limit than activation
input range chosen so |requant| < 2048 (12-bit field exact, no saturation)
crouton pack/unpack staged via cacheable buffers + bulk vector copy
transposed-V near-miss (computes P.V^T, not P.V) must fail
name: i8_attention_av_hmx
